full_page.content:
1947, October
RETREAT - Oct. 14th Tuesday - C.I.
Outstanding fortune of the poor in spirit even in temperalities. Verily 100%. St. St. Clement Hoffbauer want to say: "If in time of famine a loaf bread could be found, it would be on the table of some really poor convent."
C.II. Privileged VOW OF CHASTITY.
Privileged? Because while every soul in the grace of God is a temple of the Holy Spirit - of the Holy Trinity - the vow of chastity greatly insures the integrity of soul and body, is an outstanding feature is the vow of poverty as well as of obedi- ence and heightens resemblance between the vowing soul and not only the prototype, the ancient Arc of the Covenant, but of Mary the true Arc. . and of Jesus, ,,often and for many the most difficult.
C.III OBEDIENCE. "MASTER STROKE IN THE SACRIFICE OF SELF TO GOD'S SERVICE".
To do the will of His Heavenly Father the Second Person of the Bles'd Trinity assumed mortal flesh to be an example for all mortals in being obedient, even to the death of the Cross.
C.IV. HELL the work of MORTAL SIN.
Choice of Fools. "Artist finds youth for model Christus. Not too long afterwards seeking model for Judas finds his onetime model Christus. - work of mortal sin.
October 15th, 1947
C.I SIN - VENIAL - MORTAL
Venial sin stressed as in a way more dangerous than mortal for a religious, though incomparably less heinous in itself. It paves the way to mortal sin, blinding the soul as to the terrible consequences of the latter. Is is, however, an offense against GOD HIMSELF .... To escape a lions jaws one would not hesitate to poke himself into a cluster of thorns. Venial sin not itself vital.
C.II PRAYER.
Outstanding means of success in achieving goal of perfection. So easy - possible at all times, wheresoever we be, - always heard, always answered. Why necessity of Prayer ?.... Divinely decreed, as indicative of appreciation, - worth asking for.
